info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Offer Retrieval API provides a mechanism for clients to retrieve specific sales offer information for a customer based on a unique parameter. This API endpoint enables consumers to access detailed sales data, enhancing their ability to personalize customer interactions and marketing strategies. Typical use cases include integrating with CRM systems or customer support tools to offer targeted promotions or services. Designed for businesses looking to optimize customer engagement, the API ensures quick and efficient access to essential sales data.

get.summary: Retrieve customer offer details by ID.
get.description: This operation fetches the details of a specific customer offer using the unique identifier. It allows users to access relevant information associated with the customer offer, facilitating better insights and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve customer offer details for a specific customer identified by the unique ID 'CUST-100045'. It should contain a JSON object describing any necessary parameters or identifiers needed to fetch the information accurately.
